commentary: With market breadth scored at 45 and the deterministic gate set to CAUTION, index progress remains fragile despite three consecutive weeks of marginal advances. Strong Friday FII inflows of ₹5,250 crore were offset by DII distribution, while headline CPI breaching the RBI's threshold at 6.09% and crude firming toward $95.50 triggered a 155-point Friday pullback. In Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market-timing discipline, mixed tape breadth and macro headwinds necessitate defensive capital preservation. analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box

63MOONS.technical: Forming a 23.8% deep cup with a 10.5% handle beneath its 982.83 neckline pivot. While trading above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with RSI at 63, the base remains nascent and lacks high-volume institutional sponsorship on the right side.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite low-base optical revenue expansion to ₹153.45 crore, operating profits remain heavily constrained by persistent operational expenses and core software margin swings. ROCE sits below institutional thresholds. Zero promoter pledging is constructive, but lack of genuine bottom-line expansion fails CANSLIM criteria.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis breaks below 886.75 stop. Cut immediately if handle support violates the 50 SMA on expanding volume.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Cleared 20-session highs to touch fresh trailing-year peaks with RSI at 70. Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are aligned in an uptrend, yet price action exhibits high microcap volatility without tight Darvas consolidation.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Sales contracted 56.3% YoY to ₹44.63 crore with net profit falling 25.6% YoY. Operating margins remain razor-thin at sub-3% with weak ROE near 2.8%. While debt-to-equity is manageable at 0.34, the absence of top-line and earnings acceleration fails CANSLIM rules.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails below 104.62 stop. Sharp revenue contraction makes breakdowns swift; enforce immediate exit if 20-day lows crack.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructing a constructive double-bottom base, hovering within 1.5% of its 513.51 pivot. Price trades firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA; MACD is positive and confirming bullish momentum without signs of extension.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 showcased a sharp operational turnaround with consolidated net profit surging 83.2% YoY to ₹82.77 crore on 26.6% revenue growth. Operating margins recovered to 16.6% on API pricing recovery. Debt/equity is sound at 0.37 with ROE above 13%.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Invalidated if price breaks beneath 455.37 stop, piercing base support and the 50-day moving average.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Exemplary SEPA Stage 2 continuation breakout clearing 20-session resistance and new 52-week highs at 1003.40. Breakout confirmed by a 2.96x volume explosion, orderly base contraction, and clear relative-strength leadership.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Textbook CANSLIM profile with Q2 FY27 EPS up 155.8% YoY and sales climbing 45.9% to ₹610.45 crore. EBITDA margins expanded to 22.2% driven by robust CDMO demand and Xanthine realizations. Modest leverage and low promoter pledging complement accelerating ROCE.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis invalid below 907.75 stop. Honor disciplined stop if breakout reverses into the prior base.

ABB.technical: Large-cap leader coiled within 1.5% of its 7706.70 pivot, supported by ascending EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Volume ran 1.69x average with positive MACD, though price is consolidating near all-time resistance.
ABB.fundamental: Robust balance sheet with virtually zero debt, solid ROE of 22.4%, and record order backlog exceeding ₹10,000 crore. However, core quarterly sales grew only 6.9% YoY with regular net profit expanding 3.0%, failing the CANSLIM 25/15 growth thresholds.
ABB.risk: Fails below 7291.91 stop. Cut position if distribution volume forces price back below the 50-day line.

ABDL.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 768.77 pivot on 1.45x average volume. Moving averages are stacked in bullish Stage 2 alignment above the 200 SMA, displaying constructive price contraction after its post-IPO run.
ABDL.fundamental: India's second-largest spirits manufacturer delivered Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 15.9% YoY to ₹1,148 crore, aided by premiumization in prestige segments. EPS rose 17.4% YoY. Debt/equity stands at 0.68 with post-IPO balance sheet deleveraging underway.
ABDL.risk: Thesis fails below 714.10 stop. Exit promptly if neckline support fails on heavy distribution.
